meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 把目录、URL、粘贴的笔记或你们刚做完的对话等来源,提炼成新的 .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md 技能文件;也可以把新经验更新进已有技能。
howto.when: 当你提到 “/learn”、“turn this into a skill”、“capture this workflow” 等说法,或想把某段可复用流程沉淀成技能时触发。它只创建或改写技能,不安装社区现成技能。

say.text: /learn 我们刚才做的步骤,把它做成技能
/learn https://…/api 这页文档,做成使用技能
say.note: 先抓取页面,再生成技能

say.text: /learn 更新一下 wow-on-steam-deck 技能
say.note: 就地改写已有技能,不整篇重写

howto.what_en: Distills a directory, URL, pasted notes, or the work just done in a conversation into a new .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, and can also fold new learnings into an existing skill.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "/learn", "learn this" or similar, or want to capture a reusable workflow. It creates or refines skills rather than installing community ones.

say_en.text: /learn what we just did — turn it into a skill
/learn this API doc URL into a usage skill
say_en.note: Fetches the page, then writes the skill
Edits the existing skill in place
